spec2def(icuuc.dll icuuc.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# icuuc.dll is all Rust (icuuc-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/icuuc-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
add_cargo_module(icuuc icuuc-cargo icuuc.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE icuuc-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32)
